patterns.description: Dos fuerzas opuestas documentadas sobre el sistema de discovery en Gumroad: la plataforma y el marketplace construyen y presentan infraestructura de descubrimiento activa (Discover con 1.6M+ productos, categorías amplias, etiquetas); sellers nuevos documentan que esa infraestructura no genera tráfico orgánico para ellos antes de la primera venta/umbral de elegibilidad.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-067: Gumroad Discover page: browse over 1.6 million free and premium digital products
signal_summaries.SC-R1-069: Gumroad help center: adding categories and tags helps Gumroad show products on Discover
signal_summaries.SC-R1-065: Gumroad homepage: Discover section featuring broad list of category tags
signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Seller: Gumroad will not promote via Discover until seller earns first $10
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller with 26 products: zero organic views and zero Discover views; all views from own traffic
signal_summaries.SC-R1-049: Seller with 35 listings receiving zero organic traffic

patterns.routing_rationale: Force A documented in platform/marketplace cards (actor=platform, actor=marketplace): active discovery infrastructure presented as available. Force B documented in seller cards (actor=seller): discovery infrastructure not accessible to sellers before eligibility threshold, resulting in zero organic/Discover traffic. Both forces act on the same system (Gumroad discovery/traffic). Different actor values → passes same-actor filter. Both forces have 3+ card support.

components.label: Fuerza A — infraestructura de Discover activa presentada por plataforma
components.summary: Platform: 1.6M+ products on Discover, category navigation, tag-based discovery presented as available mechanism

components.label: Fuerza B — sellers nuevos sin acceso efectivo a Discover
components.summary: Sellers: Discover threshold blocks organic traffic before first sale/first $10; multiple sellers with 26-35 listings document zero organic reach

patterns.description: Dos fuerzas opuestas sobre el eje de autonomía del seller en la relación con Gumroad: cards de marketing/features de la plataforma presentan al seller como propietario de su storefront con flexibilidad (SC-R1-001, SC-R1-002, SC-R1-064); cards de ToS documentan que Gumroad retiene control unilateral sobre elegibilidad de productos, condiciones de pago, y política de reembolsos (SC-R1-016, SC-R1-017, SC-R1-014). Todos actores=platform.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-001: Gumroad features: powerful but simple platform enabling selling digital services directly to audience
signal_summaries.SC-R1-002: Gumroad features: flexible page editor for sellers to build storefront and customize colors
signal_summaries.SC-R1-064: Gumroad homepage: headline 'Sell anything' with video lessons and subscriptions as examples
signal_summaries.SC-R1-016: Gumroad ToS: sole discretion to determine and change eligible product categories; merchant of record; sellers prohibited from invoicing buyers
signal_summaries.SC-R1-017: Gumroad ToS: settlement schedule subject to change at Gumroad's discretion
signal_summaries.SC-R1-014: Gumroad prohibited items policy: changes may occur abruptly without notice; take effect immediately

patterns.routing_rationale: Both Force A and Force B cards have actor=platform. Same-actor filter: all signal IDs across both forces share actor=platform → same_actor_discrepancy. The contrast is between the platform's marketing/features language and its ToS/policy language, but both are platform documents. Route to rejected_grouping.

components.label: Fuerza A — plataforma presenta autonomía y flexibilidad para sellers
components.summary: Marketing/features documents: seller builds storefront, customizes it, sells anything

components.label: Fuerza B — ToS retiene control unilateral sobre condiciones clave
components.summary: Policy documents: Gumroad controls product eligibility, settlement timing, prohibited items changes without notice
